privacy.intro: How this website collects and uses the information you send when you ask about hydro jetting in Orrville.

ps: Orrville Hydro Jetting Pros helps people request hydro jetting information and connect with service providers in Orrville. This policy explains what information this website collects and how it is used. If you have a question about your information, call (877) 761-0283.

When you submit a request, the form asks for your name, phone number, an optional email address and a description of the drain issue. We use these details to review and respond to your request and help connect you with a hydro jetting service provider. Your request details may be shared with providers who can follow up about service. Please do not send financial, medical or other sensitive information through the form.

The website uses an AirChatty tracking and form script to process requests through a GoHighLevel customer relationship management system. Technical information about your visit, such as your browser, device and pages viewed, may also be collected by the website and its service providers. Google Analytics 4 may be configured on this site and may collect usage information such as page views, device and browser details, and approximate location. Google may use cookies or similar technologies as described in its policies.

You can call instead of using the form. To ask about information you submitted or request access, a correction or deletion, call (877) 761-0283. We will review requests under applicable law and any recordkeeping requirements. If this site's services or data practices change, this policy may be updated here.
